items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And that’s where I spent some time with Kenny talking [inaudible].

ctx.x: It was a great arrangement and the Boland-Clarke Big Band. And one day, at those times, in those times, I did a lot of guest recordings. You know, you play a few numbers for the radio stations. And I was in Cologne. And that’s where I spent some time with Kenny talking [inaudible]. He said, “You should come to Paris. I hope. That would be nice if you came.” So he was already settled in Paris, yes.
Okay, we’re going to have to change a tape.
